thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — collecting concrete action items and owners for rollout safety improvements. Please +1 the bits you own and add ETA.
elaine: I can take the auto-rollback proposal. Aim to draft a spec by Fri EOD. Need help deciding error_delta vs absolute error thresholds.
sam: I'll own blast-radius caps and the flag-proof checklist (what to include in the PR). Target: next Wed.
aj: I'll put together a small-run experiment and instrumentation for micro-canaries (1% -> 5% -> 20%). Will include sample sampling rules.
maria: Key ask: make ownership explicit (owner, reviewer, ETA), link to the postmortem, and add a small verification/playbook for oncall.
elaine: proto config for discussion (pseudo-yaml):
```
feature_flag:
  name: new-checkout-path
  rollout:
    stages:
      - pct: 1
        min_requests: 100
      - pct: 5
        min_requests: 500
      - pct: 20
    canary_metrics:
      error_rate: 0.02
      p99_latency_ms: 1200
    auto_rollback:
      enabled: true
      error_delta_threshold: 0.1   # 10% relative increase over baseline
      window_sec: 300
```
aj: Suggest we also add a "quarantine timer" - if canary triggers rollback, flag remains blocked for 30m before reattempt. prevents tight flapping.
sam: Agreed. Blast-radius caps proposal: each team must set a per-flag max pct for non-auth critical paths (default 5%), and critical paths require staged deploy + dedicated SRE review. I'll draft a template: owner, risk, kill-switch, metrics to watch.
maria: On recurring incident patterns: ops observed 3 incidents in last 2 months where cache eviction + burst traffic combo caused p99 spikes. We should add a pattern entry in the incident taxonomy and create an eval to repro.
elaine: I'll add an eval job to the Optimize bench to run a synthetic eviction + high qps test. ETA Mon.
aj: For telemetry: add a canary status metric that shows pct_exposed, errors_delta, and last_rollback_ts. We need dashboard alerts when pct_exposed > 10% and errors_delta > threshold.
devops-bot: noted: created issue INF-4321 (canary auto-rollback spec) and assigned to @elaine.
maria: Ownership table (quick):
- Auto-rollback spec: elaine (draft Fri) / maria review
- Blast-radius caps & checklist: sam (draft Wed) / aj review
- Micro-canary experiment & sampling: aj (experiment next iteration)
- Incident pattern + eval: elaine + sam (eval Mon)
- Dashboard + alerts: aj (alerts by Thu)

maria: Please update the issues with ETA and link back to the postmortem doc. I'll follow up in the weekly remediation sync.
sam: small note — make sure flag PR template has the explicit "rollback SLA" (how fast we must roll back after alert) and an owner oncall contact.
elaine: +1 to rollback SLA. proposing 5m for critical, 15m for non-critical paths.
aj: Calendar check: we should do a 30m handoff to walk the checklist and experiment plan.
calendar-bot: Scheduled: "Canary safety handoff" — Tue 10:00-10:30 PT with @maria @elaine @sam @aj.
maria: Thanks all. I'll close the loop after Tue sync and move to action-tracker. :thumbsup:
